card.line: Kadesh-barnea was a desert city on the southern edge of the Promised Land, where Israel refused to enter the land and was sent to wander for forty years.

moments.title: Told to take the land
moments.text: When Israel reached Kadesh-barnea, Moses said the LORD had placed the land before them. He told them to go up and take it and not to be afraid or discouraged.

moments.title: Twelve men sent to spy
moments.text: The people asked Moses to send men ahead, so he chose twelve, one from each tribe. They searched the land and brought back fruit, saying it was a good land God was giving them.

moments.title: Israel rebels against God
moments.text: The LORD told Israel to go up and possess the land, but they rebelled. They neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.

moments.title: Forty years of wandering
moments.text: Because they did not follow Him wholeheartedly, the LORD swore that the older generation would not see the land. Only Caleb and Joshua were spared, and the rest wandered until that generation was gone.

moments.title: Caleb remembers Kadesh-barnea
moments.text: Years later, Caleb reminded Joshua that Moses had sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land. He had brought back an honest report and had stayed loyal to the LORD, so he received Hebron.
